[EN] Elleon thinks we're responsible for this? Typical Hero thinking.

Can't understand anything he can't stab.
[ES] ¿Elleon cree que somos responsables de esto? Típico pensamiento de Héroe.

No puede entender nada que no pueda apuñalar.

[EN] Don't you see? We're trying to stop this from getting worse!
[ES] ¿No lo ves? ¡Estamos intentando evitar que esto empeore!

[EN] I have to go now.
[ES] Tengo que irme ahora.
